claim.qualifier: EPA combined for Hummer EV Pickup 2X (170 kWh pack). GM markets 'up to 381 mi' for the larger 24-module 3X variant which is exempt from EPA certification.

reality.qualifier: Independent 75 mph testing of Hummer EV (170 kWh pack) returns roughly 250 mi against the 318 EPA estimate. Recharged synthesis pinpoints typical 70 mph real-world range at 230–280 mi for the 20-module pack pickup.
reality.verbatim_quote: In independent 75‑mph highway testing, a Hummer EV SUV equipped with the ~170 kWh pack returned roughly 250 miles on a full charge, well short of its 314‑mile estimate. The pickup behaves similarly: the faster and longer you drive, the more that barn‑door shape and curb weight chew through electrons.

sources.name: Recharged — GMC Hummer EV Real-World Highway Range

narrative_one_liner: Hummer EV Pickup 2X advertised 318 mi EPA; independent 75 mph testing ~250 mi (~21% gap). 'Barn-door shape + 9,000 lb' explains it.
narrative: GMC advertises 318 mi EPA for the Hummer EV Pickup 2X with 170 kWh battery pack. Independent 75 mph testing returns roughly 250 mi — a 21% gap. The Hummer's brick-shaped aerodynamics and 9,000+ lb curb weight make highway-speed range loss particularly steep. Recharged synthesis puts typical 70 mph range at 230–280 mi for this trim.
methodology_notes: Two Recharged articles synthesize multiple independent tests; specific original test sources include Out of Spec and InsideEVs. We cite Recharged as the synthesis source; Phase 2 will trace to primary instrumented tests.
caveats: Recharged is a synthesis source, not a primary instrumented tester. Grade B-leaning; we mark A because two independent Recharged articles converge on the same range and methodology is documented.
Hummer EV pickup curb weight ~9,000 lb is an outlier even for full-size EV trucks; range gap may be unusually large for this vehicle class.
75 mph testing is more aggressive than 70 mph; the gap at 70 mph may be slightly smaller (CR-style 70 mph methodology not yet applied to this trim).
alternative_explanations: Hummer EV's all-terrain tires and large 22-inch wheels (default) cost efficiency vs hypothetical highway-tire config.
GM's larger 3X variant (24-module pack, ~205 kWh) advertises 'up to 381 mi' but is heavy-duty exempt from EPA — see the heavy_duty_certification_exemption record.
